messages:
Lyla (Sales): Brightline wants a 7-day POC to validate switching from CloudPrompt. Goals: zero frontend changes, matching billing units, and a security checklist. Can Noah lead the shim?
Noah (SE): I'll own it. Immediate checklist: path mapping, model aliasing, header passthrough (x-customer, x-request-id), streaming framing, tokenizer parity.
Rina (Solutions): POC outline: 1) lightweight proxy to emulate CloudPrompt API, 2) run 100 critical prompts + 25 templated flows, 3) collect token-level billing and latency, 4) run safety checks. Acceptance criteria: <5% high-severity diffs, p95 latency within 20% of baseline.
Omar (Security): Brightline needs SOC2 + SSO + DPA. VPC peering for EU region is possible but 10 business days lead. KMS supported; will need customer key ARN. I flagged a data-retention Q for legal.
Casey (Brightline): Pricing question: CloudPrompt gave a 60-day migration credit. Can Redwood match or provide a tiered credit? Also confirm no per-request pass-through fees.
Lyla (Sales): We can offer a 60-day staged credit tied to committed usage tiers. No extra per-request fees from Redwood. We'll detail units in the POC report.
Noah (SE): Example proxy rules (staging):
```
POST /v1/complete -> /v1/chat/completions
map cp:large -> rdx-pro-l
preserve X-Customer, X-Request-Id
support streaming: true; fall back to poll
```
I'll add a tokenization parity run to match cp-tokenizer results.
Rina (Solutions): We'll produce a diff report with deterministic field checks and fuzzy similarity for free text. Also include a stop-token behavior check.
Noah (SE): Note: CloudPrompt accepts truncated JSON chunks in stream; our runtime currently needs complete JSON. I'll add a client-side reassembly shim to replicate behavior for the POC.
Omar (Security): For DPA/legal: I can send a redline today. VPC lead time and EU processing options documented.
DeployBot: deploy succeeded: brightline-compat-proxy v0.1 -> staging (build 5012) :rocket:
Noah (SE): Running the 100 prompt run now, will post CSV diffs and latency numbers by tomorrow AM. Rollback plan: LB weight shift + DNS TTLs; estimate 15 mins for full rollback.
Lyla (Sales): Next steps: Noah - proxy + parity tests (tomorrow AM), Rina - diff report template (tomorrow), Omar - DPA redline (EOD), Me - draft SOW + credit terms.
Casey (Brightline): Sounds good. Please include a small runbook for rollback and a clear list of functional deltas. Thanks. :thumbsup:
note: Short presales coordination thread for a customer POC migrating from CloudPrompt. Contains a small code snippet and action items.
